note: 全部剧本为本项目原创写作，仅用于配音练习，可自由使用。myRole 表示由练习者配音的角色。

scenes.title: 咖啡馆点单
scenes.desc: 日常最实用的点单对话，语速慢、句子短。

lines.speaker: barista
lines.text: Hi there! What can I get for you today?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Hi, can I get a medium latte, please?
lines.zh: 你好，我要一杯中杯拿铁。

lines.speaker: barista
lines.text: Sure! Would you like it hot or iced?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Iced, please. It's really hot outside.
lines.zh: 冰的，谢谢。外面太热了。

lines.speaker: barista
lines.text: Great choice. Anything to eat with that?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Do you have any blueberry muffins left?
lines.zh: 你们还有蓝莓松饼吗？

lines.speaker: barista
lines.text: We sure do. That'll be six fifty. Card or cash?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Card, please. Here you go.
lines.zh: 刷卡。给你。

lines.speaker: barista
lines.text: Thanks! Your order will be ready in two minutes.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Awesome, thanks so much. Have a good one!
lines.zh: 太好了，非常感谢。祝你愉快！

scenes.title: 机场值机
scenes.desc: 出差旅行第一关：换登机牌、托运行李。

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Good morning! May I see your passport, please?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Good morning. Here you are.
lines.zh: 早上好。给您。

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you. Are you checking any bags today?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Just one suitcase. This backpack is my carry-on.
lines.zh: 只托运一个行李箱，这个背包是随身的。

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Perfect. Please place the suitcase on the scale.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Sure. Is it under the weight limit?
lines.zh: 好的。超重了吗？

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Twenty-two kilos — right on the limit. Lucky you!

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Ha, nice! Could I get a window seat if possible?
lines.zh: 哈哈，真好！可以的话能给我靠窗的座位吗？

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Done. Gate B twelve, boarding at ten forty.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Gate B twelve. Thank you very much!
lines.zh: B12 登机口。非常感谢！

scenes.title: 工作面试
scenes.desc: 经典面试场景，练习自我介绍与临场应答。

lines.speaker: hr
lines.text: Thanks for coming in. Tell me a little about yourself.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Of course. I've been working in digital marketing for five years.
lines.zh: 当然。我做数字营销已经五年了。

lines.speaker: hr
lines.text: What made you apply for this position?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Your team's creative campaigns really impressed me. I'd love to contribute to that.
lines.zh: 你们团队的创意营销让我印象深刻，我很想参与其中。

lines.speaker: hr
lines.text: What would you say is your greatest strength?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I stay calm under pressure and I learn fast when things get tough.
lines.zh: 我在压力下能保持冷静，遇到困难也学得很快。

lines.speaker: hr
lines.text: Tell me about a time you failed at something.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I once launched a campaign that flopped. I studied the data, fixed the targeting, and doubled the results.
lines.zh: 我曾做过一次失败的活动，研究数据后调整投放，效果翻了一倍。

lines.speaker: hr
lines.text: Excellent. Do you have any questions for us?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Yes — what does success look like in this role after six months?
lines.zh: 有——入职六个月后，怎样才算做得好？

scenes.title: 街头问路
scenes.desc: 在陌生城市迷路时的救命对话。

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Excuse me, I think I'm a bit lost. Could you help me?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，我好像迷路了，能帮帮我吗？

lines.speaker: local
lines.text: Of course! Where are you trying to go?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I'm looking for the Central Art Museum.
lines.zh: 我在找中央美术馆。

lines.speaker: local
lines.text: Oh, it's not far. Go straight for two blocks, then turn left.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Straight two blocks, then left. Is there a landmark?
lines.zh: 直走两个街区再左转。有什么标志建筑吗？

lines.speaker: local
lines.text: You'll see a big red clock. The museum is right behind it.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: That's super helpful. Should I take a bus instead?
lines.zh: 太有帮助了。要不要坐公交？

lines.speaker: local
lines.text: No need — it's only a ten-minute walk.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Perfect. Thank you so much for your time!
lines.zh: 太好了，非常感谢你抽出时间！

scenes.title: 看医生
scenes.desc: 描述症状、听懂医嘱，实用又有点难度的词汇。

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Hello there. What brings you in today?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I've had a sore throat and a slight fever since Monday.
lines.zh: 我从周一起嗓子疼，还有点发烧。

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Any cough, or trouble swallowing?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: A dry cough at night, and it hurts a bit when I swallow.
lines.zh: 晚上会干咳，吞咽时有点疼。

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Let me take a look. Open wide and say ah.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Ahhh. Is it serious, doctor?
lines.zh: 啊……严重吗，医生？

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: It's a mild infection. Rest, drink plenty of water, and no spicy food.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Got it. Do I need any medicine?
lines.zh: 明白了。需要吃药吗？

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: I'll prescribe something mild. You should feel better in three days.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Thank you, doctor. I really appreciate it.
lines.zh: 谢谢医生，非常感谢。

scenes.title: 大片现场：屋顶夜戏
scenes.desc: 原创悬疑片段，短句密集、情绪张力强，适合当大片主角。

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: You made it. For a second I thought you were gone.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I said I'd be here. Did anyone follow you?
lines.zh: 我说过会来。有人跟踪你吗？

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Not that I saw. But the lights in the alley went out.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: That's not a good sign. How much time do we have?
lines.zh: 这可不是好兆头。我们还有多少时间？

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Four minutes before the guard comes back around.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Then we stop talking and start moving. Hand me the key.
lines.zh: 那就别说话了，开始行动。把钥匙给我。

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Careful. This door hasn't been opened in years.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Years don't scare me. What waits on the other side does.
lines.zh: 年头吓不倒我，门后面等着的才可怕。

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Whatever happens, we finish this tonight.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Together. Now — lights out.
lines.zh: 一起。现在——熄灯。

scenes.title: 客服电话：包裹丢了
scenes.desc: 礼貌但坚定地表达不满，练习谈判语气。

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Thank you for calling. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Hi, I'm calling about order four-one-nine. It was supposed to arrive Tuesday.
lines.zh: 你好，我打电话是关于订单 419，本该周二送达。

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Let me check that for you. One moment, please.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Sure. I've already checked the tracking twice though.
lines.zh: 好的，不过我已经查过两次物流了。

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: I see it here. It appears the package was delayed in transit.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I understand delays happen, but nobody notified me at all.
lines.zh: 我能理解延误，但完全没人通知我。

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: I apologize for that. I can issue a full refund right now.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I'd rather have it redelivered. Can you guarantee it by Friday?
lines.zh: 我更希望能重新派送。能保证周五前到吗？

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Yes, I'll upgrade it to express at no extra charge.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: That works. Please email me the confirmation.
lines.zh: 这样行。请把确认邮件发给我。

scenes.title: 餐厅生日惊喜
scenes.desc: 轻松愉快的生活场景，适合练情绪表达。

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.text: Good evening! Table for how many?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Six, please. We're celebrating a birthday tonight.
lines.zh: 六位，谢谢。我们今晚庆祝生日。

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.text: Happy birthday to your friend! Follow me, please.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Could we sit by the window if it's free?
lines.zh: 如果空着的话，能坐靠窗吗？

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.text: Absolutely. What would you like to drink first?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Two sparkling waters and four iced teas.
lines.zh: 两瓶气泡水，四杯冰茶。

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.text: Nice. And are you ready to order food?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Not yet. Could you bring the cake after the main course?
lines.zh: 还没。主菜之后能上蛋糕吗？

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.text: Of course! I'll bring it out with candles lit.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Perfect. This is going to make her night!
lines.zh: 太好了，这会让她整晚都开心！

scenes.title: 租房看房
scenes.desc: 和中介谈房租、押金与配套，海外生活必备。

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Welcome in! It's a one-bedroom, fully furnished, on the fifth floor.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: It's bright. How much is the rent per month?
lines.zh: 采光不错。月租多少？

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: One thousand two hundred, and that includes water and internet.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Does that cover electricity as well, or is it separate?
lines.zh: 包含电费吗，还是另算？

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Electricity is separate. The deposit is one month's rent.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Is the deposit refundable when the lease ends?
lines.zh: 租约到期时押金会退吗？

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Yes, as long as there's no damage. The lease is twelve months.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Could I think about it for a day or two?
lines.zh: 我能考虑一两天吗？

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sure, but two other people are interested.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Then I'll decide tonight and call you back.
lines.zh: 那我今晚就决定，然后给你回电话。

scenes.title: 健身私教课
scenes.desc: 短句多、节奏快，练连读和祈使句语气。

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Ready? Start with ten squats, nice and slow.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Got it. Should I keep my back straight?
lines.zh: 明白。背要挺直吗？

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Yes, chest up, knees out. Two more, you're doing great.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Thanks. My legs are already shaking!
lines.zh: 谢谢。我腿已经在抖了！

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's normal. Rest thirty seconds, then we do planks.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: How long should I hold the plank?
lines.zh: 平板支撑要撑多久？

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Start with twenty seconds. If it hurts, stop right away.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: OK. Is it fine to train three times a week?
lines.zh: 好的。一周练三次可以吗？

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's perfect for a beginner.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Great, I'll see you on Thursday then.
lines.zh: 太好了，那周四见。

scenes.title: 课堂自我介绍
scenes.desc: 最经典的开口场景，慢速清晰，适合第一幕。

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: Everyone, we have a new classmate today. Please introduce yourself.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Hi everyone, my name is Shengfei. Nice to meet you all.
lines.zh: 大家好，我叫盛飞。很高兴认识你们。

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: Welcome, Shengfei! Where are you from?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I'm from Shenzhen, in the south of China.
lines.zh: 我来自中国南方的深圳。

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: And what do you do there?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I work in software. This is my first time studying abroad.
lines.zh: 我做软件工作。这是我第一次出国学习。

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: What made you choose this course?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I want to speak more confidently, especially at work.
lines.zh: 我想说得更自信，尤其是在工作中。

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: You're in the right place. Take a seat next to Anna.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Thank you, I'm really excited to be here.
lines.zh: 谢谢，能来这里我真的很兴奋。

scenes.title: 会议上的反对意见
scenes.desc: 礼貌而坚定地表达不同观点，高级职场表达。

lines.speaker: boss
lines.text: So the plan is to launch on the fifteenth, no exceptions.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I understand the deadline, but I'd like to flag two risks first.
lines.zh: 我理解这个期限，但我想先指出两个风险。

lines.speaker: boss
lines.text: Go ahead. What are they?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Testing isn't finished, and support hasn't been trained yet.
lines.zh: 测试还没完成，客服也还没培训。

lines.speaker: boss
lines.text: Both of those can happen after launch.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: They can, but a rough launch costs more than a short delay.
lines.zh: 可以这样做，但糟糕的上线比短暂延期代价更大。

lines.speaker: boss
lines.text: How long are we talking about?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Five days. That gets us testing done and support ready.
lines.zh: 五天。这样测试能完成，客服也能就位。

lines.speaker: boss
lines.text: Fine. Five days, and I want daily updates.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Agreed. I'll send a short report every evening.
lines.zh: 同意。我每天晚上发一份简短汇报。

scenes.title: 药店求助
scenes.desc: 紧急但需说清症状的场景，练清晰表达。

lines.speaker: pharm
lines.text: Hi, what can I help you with today?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: My daughter has a rash on her arms since this morning.
lines.zh: 我女儿从今天早上起胳膊上起了疹子。

lines.speaker: pharm
lines.text: Is she itching a lot, or is there any fever?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: She keeps scratching, but no fever so far.
lines.zh: 她一直在抓，但目前没发烧。

lines.speaker: pharm
lines.text: Has she eaten anything unusual in the last day?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: We tried a new brand of yogurt yesterday.
lines.zh: 我们昨天试了个新牌子的酸奶。

lines.speaker: pharm
lines.text: Could be a mild allergy. I'd suggest a gentle cream for now.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Should I take her to see a doctor?
lines.zh: 需要带她去看医生吗？

lines.speaker: pharm
lines.text: If it spreads or she has trouble breathing, go straight to the ER.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Understood. Thank you, that's very clear.
lines.zh: 明白了。谢谢你，说得很清楚。

scenes.title: 侦探剧：最后的推理
scenes.desc: 原创悬疑收尾戏，长句与情绪并重，适合当主角独白。

lines.speaker: suspect
lines.text: You have no proof. You're just guessing, like everyone else.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I'm not guessing. I've been listening to what you didn't say.
lines.zh: 我不是在猜。我一直在听你没说出口的部分。

lines.speaker: suspect
lines.text: That's not evidence. That's a trick.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: The door was locked from inside, yet the window was open all night.
lines.zh: 门是从里面锁上的，可窗户整晚都开着。

lines.speaker: suspect
lines.text: So someone climbed in. That proves I'm innocent.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: It proves the person who climbed in never needed to leave.
lines.zh: 这反而说明，爬进来的人根本不需要离开。

lines.speaker: suspect
lines.text: You can't prove any of that.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Actually, I can. The dust on that windowsill has your fingerprints.
lines.zh: 事实上我能。那个窗台上的灰尘有你的指纹。

lines.speaker: suspect
lines.text: …Then ask me what you already know.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Why did you do it? That's the only question left.
lines.zh: 你为什么要这么做？这是唯一剩下的问题了。
